ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. filed a routine daily report on its ongoing share buyback program for September 1, 2026. On this date, the company repurchased 58,774 equity shares at an average price of ₹ 296.05, primarily through the NSE, bringing the cumulative total of shares bought back to 883,802. This activity consistently reduces outstanding shares, a typical strategy to enhance shareholder value and EPS, with no red flags identified in this standard regulatory disclosure.
